SPEECH AUDIOMETRY
The patient’s ability to hear and understand the speech is
measured in speech audiometry. The two parameters studied
are: SRT and speech discrimination (SD) score (Table 4).
SPEECH RECEPTION THRESHOLD (SRT)
Speech reception threshold (SRT) is the minimum intensity at
which 50% of spondee words are repeated correctly.


Spondee words: These are two syllable words with equal
stress on each syllable, such as oatmeal, popcorn, shipwreck,
black-night, blackboard, football, eardrum, sunset and
daydream.

The expected exposures can be calculated and documented,

Measuring Devices for Radiation Fields
They include film badge, thermoluminescent dosimeter (TLD)
badge, optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) badge, pocket
ionization (Ion) chamber, and electronic dosimeters.
RADIOACTIVE CONTAMINATION
The radioactive material, which is not in a sealed source container,
may spread onto other objects. Contamination happens when
radioactive material is deposited on skin, clothing, materials, or

record.text: any other undesired place. The radioactive contamination can
spread. An individual contaminated with radioactive material
will receive radiation till the radioactive material is not removed.

External contamination: The radioactive material is on the 
skin or clothing.
Internal contamination: The radioactive material can be
breathed in, swallowed, or absorbed through wounds.

Environmental contamination: The spread unconfined of 
radioactive material.
SAFETY AROUND SOURCES OF RADIATION

A single >100 mSv radiation exposure delivered to human 
body over a short period of time can be injurious to health. 
The acutely delivered very high radiation doses (atomic bomb 
survivors) can increase the occurrence cancer and can cause 
negative genetic effects.
